_note: USD per 1M tokens, list prices read on 2026-10-16. Bedrock global cross-region inference bills at the vendors' list prices (AWS model cards). Gemini 3.8 Flash promo price runs through 2026-12-31 (then 1.50 / 7.50); Gemini 4 Argon promo through 2026-11-30 (then 4.00 / 20.00). cache_read is the price for cached input tokens where the vendor publishes one; the judge prompt is not cacheable as written, so it rarely applies. cache_write: Bedrock bills prompt-cache writes at 1.25x the input rate (AWS model cards); Bedrock's implicit caching for OpenAI models reports the whole prompt as cache-write tokens on a cache miss, so input_tokens is near zero and cache_write_tokens carries the prompt. Gemini has no separate write charge beyond storage, so cache_write = in there (it never applies: Gemini reports cached tokens inside prompt_token_count).
